mapper.select: SELECT ID, PARTY_NAME, PARENT_ID, ATTRIBUTE_01, ORG_IDENTITY, ATTRIBUTE_02, ATTRIBUTE_03 FROM PARTY_ORGANIZATION WHERE ORG_IDENTITY = #{orgIdentity} ORDER BY TREE_SORTS, TREE_SORT, ID

SELECT DISTINCT CAST(TO_CHAR(MEET_DATE, 'YYYY') AS INTEGER) + CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(MEET_DATE, 'MM') >= '10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ASSESSMENT_YEAR FROM DYN_THREE_FOUR WHERE MEET_DATE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ASSESSMENT_YEAR DESC

SELECT ID, PARTY_ID, MEET_TYPE, MEET_DATE, CREATION_DATE FROM DYN_THREE_FOUR WHERE MEET_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND MEET_DATE < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND MEET_TYPE IN ('0', '1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6') ORDER BY MEET_DATE, ID
